next: Found: Akhand Paath reads Shabads one after another, so the app follows it with the same line follower as Kirtan (4 s window). The shorter-window builds (3.0 s, 2.5 s) that made Kirtan 0.1-0.17 s faster are now running on the Akhand Paath recordings, practice and held-back, on VM 2. If one fixes the fast readers without hurting the slow ones, it is the fix.
now: Held-back recordings (12, 1.74 h, 6 videos at normal and 1.35x speed) on 9.0.4: right Bani 98% (goal met), but right pangti 84.4% and 1.3 s behind (practice: 96%, 0.33 s). Per video: 2 videos are perfect (98% pangti, 0.1 s behind); 4 videos have the screen about one pangti behind (pangti 77-88%, 1.3-1.9 s behind, same-or-next pangti 95-98%). The answer keys are right: in all three checked videos the slide changes about 0.25 s after the reader starts the pangti. The lagging videos are fast readers (pangtis of about 2 s), where the follower lands one pangti late.
